description: Companies House register detail for a UK company by entity id: registered address, status, company type, incorporation date, SIC industry codes, and the filing/compliance layer — accounts type, last-filed and next-due dates (flagged when OVERDUE), confirmation-statement status, outstanding mortgage charges, and former ('also known as') names. Use this for 'where is X registered / what does it file / is it overdue / what was it called before'. Returns `{ entity, company_details, provenance, note, source }` — this is the best-populated of the UK detail tools, measured 2026-08-11 at 45 of 48 sampled UK company entities carrying a non-empty `company_details` (contrast get_financials at 11 of the same 48). Get the id from search_entities or lookup_by_identifier.
name: get_company_details
